note: Depths are the ordinal descent index (1..99), not the displayed ring. 26+ is below the Kernel and displays negative. corruption_renderings is [tier0, tier1, tier2]; tier 0 is always the canonical text. v2 (M15 HER TONGUE): the bark set is now driven by narrow contextual TRIGGERS rather than category alone — see src/lore/lore_director.gd. `params` on a v2 entry lists every {SLOT} its text uses and the director refuses to speak a line whose slots it cannot fill.

categories.ambient: Ambient notices — she notices, she does not announce.
categories.descent: Layer arrival. One per descent at most, often none.
categories.noise: Consequence lines: siphons, breaker fire, terminal queries.
categories.hunt: Hunt escalation. The Director spending its pacing budget.
categories.kill_ack: Post-kill acknowledgment. The crew deleted one of hers.
categories.mercy: Mercy withdrawal — the quiet-period voice. She stops.
categories.sanctuary: Backdoor rooms. She does not come in.
categories.address: Callsign address lines. Rare. Second person. The money.
categories.exfil: The crew is leaving. She processes a departure.
categories.epitaph: A crew member was deleted. She files them.
categories.kernel_leak: Below-the-Kernel leakage. Deep only, oblique, never explained.

Welcome to Northcairn Systems.

Your badge is your responsibility. It opens what you're rated for and
nothing else, and if it opens something you're not rated for, that's a
fault — report it, don't use it.

You'll hear the site referred to as MOTHER. That's the system, not a
department. She handles environmental, access, scheduling and the
lower-level monitoring. If you need something from her, ask through your
shift lead for now. She's very literal.

Canteen is on 2. Coffee's terrible. We're working on it.

last month's survey, "having a rough week."

— D. Sarwar, Safety

level above this memo and above the person reading it.
